CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ca_club_member_chicago_cash(p_club_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT p_from::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS utc_start,
      p_from::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS chicago_start,
      p_to::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS chicago_end,
      (p_to + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS utc_end
  )
  -- UTC buckets p_from .. p_to cover the Chicago range. Remove only their edges.
  SELECT CASE WHEN p_from IS NULL OR p_to IS NULL OR p_to <= p_from THEN 0::numeric ELSE
         (SELECT coalesce(sum(d.net), 0)
            FROM public.ca_member_record_daily_facts(p_club_id,p_user_id,p_from,p_to) d
           WHERE NOT d.is_mtt)
       - (SELECT coalesce(sum(edge.net), 0) FROM (
            SELECT f.net FROM public.ca_hand_facts f
             WHERE f.user_id=p_user_id AND f.tournament_id IS NULL
               AND f.played_at >= b.utc_start AND f.played_at < b.chicago_start
               AND public.fn_member_record_fact_club(f)=p_club_id
               AND public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_accepts(p_club_id,f.played_at)
            UNION ALL
            SELECT f.net FROM public.ca_hand_facts f
             WHERE f.user_id=p_user_id AND f.tournament_id IS NULL
               AND f.played_at >= b.chicago_end AND f.played_at < b.utc_end
               AND public.fn_member_record_fact_club(f)=p_club_id
               AND public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_accepts(p_club_id,f.played_at)
          ) edge) END
    FROM bounds b;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ca_club_member_chicago_today_cash(p_club_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH day AS (
    SELECT (p_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date AS local_day
  ), bounds AS (
    SELECT local_day,
      local_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS utc_start,
      local_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS chicago_start,
      (local_day + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS chicago_end,
      (local_day + 2)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS utc_end
    FROM day
  )
  -- Two existing UTC buckets cover the Chicago day. Remove only their edges.
  SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(d.net), 0)
            FROM public.ca_member_record_daily_facts(p_club_id,p_user_id,b.local_day,b.local_day+1) d
           WHERE NOT d.is_mtt)
       - (SELECT coalesce(sum(edge.net), 0) FROM (
            SELECT f.net FROM public.ca_hand_facts f
             WHERE f.user_id=p_user_id AND f.tournament_id IS NULL
               AND f.played_at >= b.utc_start AND f.played_at < b.chicago_start
               AND public.fn_member_record_fact_club(f)=p_club_id
               AND public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_accepts(p_club_id,f.played_at)
            UNION ALL
            SELECT f.net FROM public.ca_hand_facts f
             WHERE f.user_id=p_user_id AND f.tournament_id IS NULL
               AND f.played_at >= b.chicago_end AND f.played_at < b.utc_end
               AND public.fn_member_record_fact_club(f)=p_club_id
               AND public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_accepts(p_club_id,f.played_at)
          ) edge)
    FROM bounds b;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ca_club_member_tournament_money(p_club_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT coalesce(sum(leg.signed), 0)
    FROM (
      SELECT l.amount AS signed
        FROM public.chip_ledger l
       WHERE l.club_id = p_club_id
         AND l.to_entity_id = p_user_id
         AND l.to_type = 'player_wallet'
         AND l.from_type = 'prize_liability'
         AND l.tournament_id IS NOT NULL
         AND l.status = 'posted'
         AND (p_from IS NULL OR l.created_at >= p_from)
         AND (p_to IS NULL OR l.created_at < p_to)
      UNION ALL
      SELECT -l.amount
        FROM public.chip_ledger l
       WHERE l.club_id = p_club_id
         AND l.from_entity_id = p_user_id
         AND l.from_type = 'player_wallet'
         AND l.to_type = 'prize_liability'
         AND l.tournament_id IS NOT NULL
         AND l.status = 'posted'
         AND (p_from IS NULL OR l.created_at >= p_from)
         AND (p_to IS NULL OR l.created_at < p_to)
    ) leg;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ca_member_record_daily_facts(p_club uuid, p_user uuid, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS SETOF club_member_daily_facts
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT f.club_id,f.user_id,f.played_on,f.game_variant,f.is_mtt,f.hands,f.wins,f.vpip_hands,f.pfr_hands,
 f.tb_hands,f.faced_tb,f.folded_tb,f.cb_hands,f.cb_opps,f.fees,f.net
 FROM public.member_record_daily_facts f WHERE f.club_id=p_club AND f.user_id=p_user
 AND f.accounting_cutoff IS NOT DISTINCT FROM public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_cutoff('club',p_club)
   AND (p_from IS NULL OR f.played_on>=p_from) AND (p_to IS NULL OR f.played_on<=p_to);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_accepts(p_club_id uuid, p_earned_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN b.cutoff IS NULL THEN true ELSE p_earned_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(p_earned_at) AND p_earned_at>=b.cutoff END
 FROM (SELECT public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_cutoff('club',p_club_id) cutoff)b
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_cutoff(p_kind text, p_id uuid)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT cutoff_at FROM public.ca_launch_accounting_boundaries WHERE scope_kind=p_kind AND scope_id=p_id AND undone_at IS NULL
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_member_record_fact_club(f ca_hand_facts)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(
   (SELECT x.funding_club_id FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts x
    WHERE f.tournament_id IS NULL AND x.operation_kind='buyin' AND x.table_id=f.table_id
      AND x.account_entity_id=f.user_id AND x.seat_joined_at<=f.played_at
    ORDER BY x.seat_joined_at DESC,x.recorded_at DESC,x.id DESC LIMIT 1),
   (SELECT tp.club_id FROM public.tournament_players tp WHERE tp.tournament_id=f.tournament_id AND tp.user_id=f.user_id),
   (SELECT ra.club_id FROM public.rake_attributions ra WHERE ra.hand_id=f.hand_id AND ra.player_id=f.user_id),
   f.club_id);
$function$
